items.name: Vibe Cafe Order
items.description: QR ordering for take-away coffee shops: customers scan, pick drinks, sizes and toppings and track their order in real time; the owner gets orders with a sound alert on a 3-column dashboard and toggles menu items from a phone.
items.problem: At rush hour a take-away shop brews and takes verbal orders at once, so drinks get mixed up, orders get missed and customers leave.
items.myRole: Designed and built everything: the customer app, the owner dashboard, the database and real-time sync.
tasks: QR menu: customers pick drinks, size, toppings and notes and order without installing an app.
Real-time dashboard with a sound alert for new orders and Waiting → Brewing → Done columns.
Customers track their order live and can cancel while it is still waiting.
The owner toggles items, changes prices and uploads photos from a phone.
items.impact: Customers order in about 30 seconds; the owner gets complete orders without leaving the espresso machine.
